verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs describe receiving real-time notifications about email events, and separately describe receiving and processing incoming emails through webhooks. Together these indicate first-party outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is thin, though: docs-3 does not explicitly say "webhook", and docs-8 covers only inbound-email parsing. missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription API, event-type catalog, payload/signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
